items.title: Frank Murray Interview, 1960-05-12
items.q: His name was Spencer Murray. He had his own band.

ctx.x: A lot of musicians in that neighborhood when you were a kid? A lot of music?

Well, my father was a musician. What did he play? He played guitar. In fact, all my family, my uncle, on my mother's side, they was musicians out in the country, in Morripass, Louisiana. That's in Livingston Parish. And my father, he played at Tom Anderson. That was located then on North Ramport, in the 200 block of North Ramport. Same block where they, I think they have the athletic club down in there now. He played over there. What did he play with there? Well, he had his own band. And what was his name? His…
And what about your relatives in Livingston? What were their names? Oh, Batiste. Batiste. Can you give me the instruments they played? Well, my uncle played violin. And his name? His name? His name?
